summary: Equinix, Inc., through its indirect wholly owned subsidiary Equinix Europe 2 Financing Corporation LLC, filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a multi-tranche offering of senior notes across four maturities, unconditionally guaranteed on an unsecured basis by Equinix, Inc. Terms including principal amounts, coupons, and maturity dates are left blank in this preliminary filing. Proceeds are intended to finance or refinance eligible projects under a green-bond-style allocation framework, with net proceeds stated as blank. Notes rank pari passu with existing unsubordinated unsecured debt and structurally subordinated to subsidiary liabilities; a change-of-control triggering event requires a 101% repurchase offer. The issuer intends to list each series on the Nasdaq Bond Exchange within 30 days of issue. This is a routine debt capital-raising shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch for final pricing, tranche sizing, and any credit-spread implications for Equinix's leverage profile.
